stem: ![](asset:P000489-stem-1)With what minimum velocity $v_{0}$ should block be projected from left end A towards end B such that it reaches the other end B of conveyor belt which is moving with constant velocity v ? Friction coefficient between block and belt is μ.

assets.alt: A conveyor belt of length L between rollers A and B, with its top moving left at speed v. A block of mass m placed at A moves right at v₀; the friction coefficient is μ.
